name: csp-wildcard-matches-subdomains-only
hook: CSP img-src exact-host vs wildcard for same-origin subdomains
body:
In CSP img-src (and other directives), an exact-host like `gravatar.com` does NOT match `www.gravatar.com`. Only `*.gravatar.com` matches subdomains. An apex domain and its www subdomain are separate hosts in CSP matching.

**Why:** Issue #2451 - 2 CSP violations per page load because `gravatar.com` was in img-src but the actual URL was `www.gravatar.com`. Changing to `*.gravatar.com` fixed it.

**How to apply:** When adding domains to CSP img-src, always use `*.domain.com` pattern if the URL may have a `www.` prefix, even if the apex domain is listed separately.
why: CSP host matching treats `domain.com` and `www.domain.com` as distinct hosts. The wildcard `*.domain.com` matches subdomains but NOT the apex. To cover both, list `*.domain.com`.
